analyst_view.overall: Early view: with a month to go, Getafe (30th, one point) host Inter Club d'Escaldes (35th, no points) on matchday 5. Getafe are 15th in La Liga with only eight goals in 12 games, and the Coliseum is under renovation with a reduced capacity. Domi Berlanga, sent off against Red Star, should have served his ban by then if it is the usual one match.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.0 goals, 2.2 for Getafe. I lean lower: Getafe's attack is one of La Liga's weakest, and a 2-0 or 2-1 win fits them better than a big score, even against a side that has lost all three games.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.6 corners, 6.9 for Getafe. Getafe at home should have a lot of territory, which the split reflects.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.5 cards, already high for Getafe's combative style. Inter had a man sent off last time, but nothing else moves the number this far out.

shots.text: The numbers say 27.6 shots, 20.0 for Getafe. I lean lower: Getafe rarely produce shots in bulk, as eight league goals in 12 games suggest, and their focus may be on the league relegation fight.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.5 shots on target. For the same reason, Getafe's poor attacking output, I lean slightly lower.
